title: Whole Life Insurance Contract Periods: Free Look, Contestability and Suicide Exclusion
content:
Each Ashgrove tier of Whole Life Insurance carries a free-look period counted in calendar days from the policy delivery date, a longer or equal free-look period where the sale replaced existing coverage, a contestable period and a suicide exclusion period counted in years from the issue date (the contestable period for statements in a reinstatement application runs from the reinstatement date).

| Tier | Free-look period (calendar days from delivery) | Free-look period when the sale replaced existing coverage | Contestable period | Suicide exclusion period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | 30 | 30 | 2 years | 2 years |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | 10 | 30 | 2 years | 2 years |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | 10 | 30 | 2 years | 2 years |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | 10 | 30 | 2 years | 2 years |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | 10 | 30 | 2 years | 2 years |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | 10 | 30 | 2 years | 2 years |

## Reading the periods (hypothetical deliveries)

- A Paid-Up at 100 policy delivered on June 1 that did not replace other coverage has a free-look period of 10 days; had the sale replaced existing coverage, the period would be 30 days.
- A Final Expense policy has 30 days in either case.
